age-calculator.seoTitle: Age Calculator – Completed Years from Date of Birth
age-calculator.title: How completed age changes at a birthday
age-calculator.introduction: Age is based on completed birthdays, not the difference between calendar years alone. This tool calculates age against the current browser date.
age-calculator.input: Born July 20, 2000; consider July 19 and July 20, 2026.
age-calculator.output: 25 completed years on July 19; 26 completed years on July 20.
age-calculator.limitation: The calculator does not accept a custom as-of date and does not separately report months or days. Leap-day legal conventions may vary.

proportion-calculator.seoTitle: Proportion Calculator – Solve Missing Ratio Values
proportion-calculator.title: Solve a missing fourth term
proportion-calculator.introduction: A proportion works when both ratios compare quantities in the same order and the rate is constant.
proportion-calculator.input: Six packages cost nine units. What would ten packages cost at the same unit price?
proportion-calculator.limitation: A zero denominator or a nonlinear relationship makes the simple proportion unsuitable.

tip-calculator.seoTitle: Tip Calculator – Bill, Tip and Per-Person Split
tip-calculator.title: Split an eighty-dollar check
tip-calculator.introduction: Enter the bill basis, percentage and a positive whole number of diners to calculate a transparent even split.
tip-calculator.output: Tip $12, overall total $92, and $46 per person.
tip-calculator.limitation: Check whether tax, an existing gratuity or service charges are already included; those are not inferred from the input.

random-text-generator.seoTitle: Random Text Generator – UI Testing and Placeholder Copy
random-text-generator.title: Stress-test a responsive layout
random-text-generator.introduction: Use different lengths of generated text as disposable test data before real content is available.
random-text-generator.input: Generate a short label and then a much longer paragraph for the same card.
random-text-generator.output: Compare wrapping, truncation, card height and behavior on narrow screens. Exact generated text varies.
random-text-generator.limitation: Generated placeholders are not reviewed factual content and should not be published as finished copy.

morse-code-translator.seoTitle: Morse Code Translator – Encode and Decode Text
morse-code-translator.title: Encode the three-letter SOS example
morse-code-translator.introduction: Morse characters must be separated clearly for reliable text decoding.
morse-code-translator.limitation: Written symbols represent codes, not timing or real transmitted signals; unsupported characters may need review.

list-to-text.seoTitle: List to Text Converter – Join Lines with Separators
list-to-text.title: Join three lines with commas
list-to-text.introduction: Turn a line-by-line list into a text sequence, choosing a delimiter appropriate to the destination.
list-to-text.input: alpha on line one, beta on line two, gamma on line three.
list-to-text.limitation: A simple join is not a full CSV serializer; delimiters inside data fields require separate escaping rules.

word-counter.seoTitle: Word Counter – Count Words, Characters and Lines
word-counter.title: Check a short sentence
word-counter.introduction: Word limits and character limits measure different things; review the requirement before editing a draft to fit.
word-counter.output: 3 words. Character count includes letters, spaces and punctuation.
word-counter.limitation: Hyphens, emoji and scripts without spaces can lead to differences across counting conventions.
